name: harmonica-icons
notes: Single solid layer, currentColor only. NO duotone, NO opacity variants, NO background tiles/badges behind glyphs.
Interior details are punched holes via fill-rule=evenodd, never a second tone.
Boxes rx=3; line segments are filled capsules; polygon vertices smoothed with quadratic cuts. Zero sharp 90-degree corners.
No strokes anywhere. No hex. No transforms.
